title: Filter Controller modular execution
purpose: Execute the completed Filter Controller audits without returning to monolithic control, renderer, or CSS files.
entry_condition: PHASE-FC-006 audits are complete and DEC-EIT-014 is accepted.
exit_condition: The Filter Controller has a modular style/control/render/CSS architecture and each audited filter type has its own implementation task queued behind that architecture.
acceptance_criteria: No new filter polish task starts before the line-budget guard and StyleControls split are complete.
Style control modules preserve existing Elementor control IDs and saved-widget compatibility.
Renderer and CSS extraction are behavior-preserving before new visual behavior is added.
Each audited filter type has a separate implementation task with source inputs and QA boundary.
No new filter type is implemented until TASK-FC-063 classifies it as a real type, variant, module concern, configuration, or out-of-scope idea.
Guilherme remains final QA for nuanced visual/editor interaction checks.
